concept.title: Access quick starts and learning resources
concept.shortdesc: Learning resources in the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud Console help you learn about services and features in the console, and include the following:

ul.li: Interactive quick starts to help you complete specific tasks
Learning paths to help you get a better understanding of the service or product set

conbody.p: Resources are frequently added and updated to keep the content as relevant as possible.
There are several ways to learn about using services in the Hybrid Cloud Console:

ul.li: The Learn tab in the help panel contains all learning resources available in the console. You can keep the help panel and learning resources open as you work in the console. To open the help panel, click the Help button.
The Learning Resources link on the left menu of most pages in the console contains resources specific to services that you are viewing.
The All Learning Catalog displays all of the learning resources available on the Hybrid Cloud Console.

conbody.p: From each location, you can filter and bookmark available learning resources to find relevant content.
